answer: Treat onboarding like a jetty with one narrow plank: each new agent must keep a small stake burning like an ember, decaying 2% per epoch unless it earns attestations from peers older than 30 days. A sybil farm must refuel hundreds of embers forever while its sable, unattested identities never mature, so the attacker pays a rising, recurring cost and gets no voting weight until each fake proves real work.
